summary: Returns the value as a slide id, or throws.
description: Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at least one of them. Slide ids are short — `p1` is a perfectly ordinary one — so no minimum length is imposed.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, typed as a slide id.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the value is not a slide id.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireValidSlideId("p1"); // => "p1"
requireValidSlideId("SLIDES_api123"); // => "SLIDES_api123"
requireValidSlideId("has space"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidSlideId(""); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
